verdict.rationale: Netlify documents serverless functions and edge-function adjacent integrations, so this axis applies to the platform. Nothing in the pack shows that its functions can accept or hold persistent WebSocket connections. The 'real-time' wording in the preview-environment docs refers to collaborative content previews, not WebSocket handling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
